name: Shelly Pro 3EM-400
summary: DIN-rail 3-phase energy meter with 400A CTs, neutral CT input, LAN/Wi-Fi, 60-day logging; no relay.

f.inputs: 3 L + N voltage inputs, 4 CT inputs (A/B/C/N)

extra.no_load_threshold: 30 VA per channel — energy not accumulated below
extra.calibration_min_load: 500 W per channel (spec table says 5000 W)
extra.contactor: requires Shelly Pro Addon (Switch Add-on) — no built-in relay

gotchas: No built-in relay — contactor control needs the Shelly Pro 3EM Switch Add-on
Loads under 30 VA/channel aren't accumulated into energy totals — poor for tiny circuits
Neutral CT is optional and not included; KB doesn't clearly say the 3 phase CTs ship in box
DIN-rail module — panel install by an electrician
Overkill/expensive for ≤120A legs — Shelly 3EM covers that range
best_for: 200-400A services, solar/PV import-export, and commercial 3-phase sub-metering with LAN
